text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC).

The lab results show an isolated elevation in Alkaline Phosphatase (460 U/L) with normal bilirubin and only mildly elevated transaminases, which is characteristic of cholestatic liver disease. Given your history of ulcerative colitis and severe pruritus, PBC is the most likely diagnosis, though I need to confirm with specific antibody testing. REQUEST TEST: Antimicrosomal Antibodies (AMA).
